program.name: Every Day Different
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Sixty days and no two alike: strength, cardio, combat and core, each in a new format every time.
program.about: Sixty days and no two the same. Each day picks a kind of training, push, pull, legs, jumps, boxing, core and more, and a format, straight sets, supersets, a circuit, an EMOM, an AMRAP or a Tabata, and that pair never comes back. Strength days end with a short burst of cardio or a short core circuit; cardio and core days end with a short lift. The same kind of training never lands two days running. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier weights.
